item.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
item.description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

item.title: 'End Times Fascism' looks at supremacist groups uniting around end-of-the-world ideas
item.description: Authors Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor identify supremacists that have, despite ideological differences, converged around the conviction that they are part of an elite destined to survive an apocalypse.

item.description: A 300-year-old Mexican musical tradition is finding new life around the world — one sweaty, joyous, all-night fandango at a time.

item.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
item.description: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

item.title: 'Acting is doing': Willem Dafoe on what people get wrong about acting

item.title: 'The Disappearers' is a fiercely personal novel that hits like a tidal wave
item.description: Marlon James' new novel chronicles the events surrounding a vicious anti-gay attack in Jamaica in the late 1980s. Shortlisted for the Booker Prize, The Disappearers churns with passion and ideas.
